admission.justification: This clause guards the zero-cost claim for a quiet tick; removing it would make every three-second tick start a host read.

conditions: No stamped end is new this tick and no stored report is due for a recheck: the tick starts no usage read.
exclusions: A due report stays due until a read records its attempt.
statement: A tick with neither a limited report due for recheck nor a new stamped end performs no usage read.
